note.text:
Parts of the mouth: teeth (one tooth), gums (the pink flesh around the teeth), the tongue.
Kinds of teeth: incisors (front teeth for cutting), canines (pointed teeth for tearing), molars (back teeth for chewing and grinding).
Cleaning: a toothbrush, toothpaste, dental floss (thread to clean between the teeth), mouthwash.
Problems: tooth decay or a cavity (a hole in a tooth), toothache (pain), bleeding gums, bad breath.
Treatment: a check-up (a visit to look at the teeth), a filling (the dentist fills the hole), an extraction (the dentist takes the tooth out), braces (wires that straighten teeth).
Plural: one tooth, two teeth.

worked_example.problem: {n} has a hole in a back tooth. Use the dental words to say what it is and what the dentist may do.
steps: A back tooth is a molar. A hole in a tooth is a cavity, caused by tooth decay.
The dentist may clean the hole and put in a filling.
If the tooth is too damaged, the dentist does an extraction: he takes it out.
worked_example.answer: {n} has a cavity in a molar; the dentist may give a filling or do an extraction.

cards.idea: Teeth have different jobs: incisors cut, canines tear, molars grind.
example: We bite into a mango with our incisors.
We chew meat with our molars.

cards.idea: We clean our teeth with a toothbrush and toothpaste, and between them with dental floss.
example: Brush every morning and every night.
Floss removes food between the teeth.

cards.idea: A cavity is a hole made by tooth decay. The dentist may put in a filling or do an extraction.
example: An extraction takes the tooth out.

cards.idea: Tooth is singular; teeth is plural.

e: You brush all of them: teeth.

questions.prompt: One sentence uses a dental word wrongly. Which one?

right.text: The dentist gave me a filling.
I clean between my teeth with floss.
My little sister has two new teeth.

wrong.text: I cut my food with my molars at the front.
wrong.explain: Molars are at the back; incisors cut at the front.

wrong.text: The dentist put an extraction in my tooth.
wrong.explain: An extraction takes a tooth out; a filling goes in.

wrong.text: Two of my tooth are loose.
wrong.explain: Two teeth: the plural of tooth is teeth.
